patterns.title: Single AWS EC2 instance (private by default)
patterns.purpose: A single Linux or Windows EC2 instance in a dedicated VPC and subnet for a self-contained lab, with no inbound internet access unless explicitly requested.
securityObservations: No internet gateway, route, or public IP is created unless the author opts in.
A security group is attached and allows no inbound traffic by default.
No key pair private material is ever embedded; only an existing key-pair name may be referenced.
costConsiderations: Instance type is the dominant cost driver; prefer a small general-purpose or burstable type for labs.
A public IPv4 address, if requested, incurs an hourly charge.
The root EBS volume incurs per-GB storage cost for the lab duration.
limitations: Region and instance-type availability and quotas cannot be confirmed by this tool.
AMI ids are region-specific; an SSM public parameter alias is preferred.

evidence.sourceTitle: AWS CloudFormation EC2 instance in a VPC (resource reference)
evidence.rationale: The single-EC2 composition follows the documented Instance + VPC + Subnet + SecurityGroup relationship.
